# crosswork_nso_provider_policies (Resource)

This resource can manage the device onboarding policy of an NSO provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_nso_provider_policies" "example" {
  provider_name         = "nso"
  match                 = true
  match_rule            = "*"
  onboard_to_nso        = true
  onboard_to_nso_rule   = "*"
  onboard_from_nso      = false
  onboard_from_nso_rule = "*"
  sync_from_nso         = true
  sync_from_nso_rule    = "*"
  check_sync            = true
  check_sync_rule       = "*"
  neds = [
    {
      ned  = "cisco-iosxr-cli-7.76"
      rule = "product_info.software_type = 'IOS XR*'"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_name` (String) Name of the NSO provider the policy belongs to

### Optional

- `check_sync` (Boolean) Check the sync status of the devices on the NSO provider
- `check_sync_rule` (String) Expression that selects the devices whose sync status is checked
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `match` (Boolean) Match devices of Crosswork and of the NSO provider by their IP address
- `match_rule` (String) Expression that selects the devices that are matched, for example `*` or `host_name = 'build-*'`
- `neds` (Attributes List) Rules that select the NED an onboarded device gets. Both the NED and the rule are required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--neds))
- `onboard_from_nso` (Boolean) Add the devices that the NSO provider has and Crosswork is missing to Crosswork
- `onboard_from_nso_rule` (String) Expression that selects the devices that are added to Crosswork
- `onboard_to_nso` (Boolean) Add the devices that Crosswork has and the NSO provider is missing to the NSO provider
- `onboard_to_nso_rule` (String) Expression that selects the devices that are added to the NSO provider
- `sync_from_nso` (Boolean) Run a sync-from on the NSO provider after the devices are onboarded
- `sync_from_nso_rule` (String) Expression that selects the devices that are synchronised

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--neds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `neds`

Required:

- `ned` (String) Name of the NED, for example `cisco-iosxr-cli-7.76`
- `rule` (String) Expression that selects the devices that get the NED, for example `product_info.software_type = 'IOS XR*'`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_nso_provider_policies.example "<provider_name>"
```
